Name: Video Game Weapons
Author: firstclone
Description:
These are just some weapon skins I made that give me serotonin so I thought I'd share them with you all! Currently allows replacement of the Galaxy Sword, Galaxy Dagger, Galaxy Hammer, Infinity Blade, Infinity Dagger, and Infinity Gavel. Available replacements are:

Buster Sword (Final Fantasy 7)
Crucible Blade (Doom Eternal)
Diamond Sword (Minecraft)
Energy Sword (Halo)
Keyblade (Kingdom Hearts)
Lightsaber (Star Wars)
Master Sword (Legend of Zelda)
Mjolnir (Marvel)
Monado (Xenoblade Chronicles)
Wolverine's Claws (Marvel)

Also included is an option to turn your slingshot into an Aperture Science Handheld Portal Device. Because of the way the game animates slingshots, it currently replaces all three. There are also three options for replacing the model of the Explosive Ammo: Captain America's shield, a TRON identity disc, and a Poké Ball.

This is the first mod I've ever shared for any game. Feel free to leave tips, feedback, or requests!
